backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister implementing RBAC, invoice storage, payment entry tracking, user profiles, and admin-only operations like uploading invoices and clearing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record describing the invoice upload template feature, its related files, components, and associated requirement ID.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries of all frontend files, outlining major components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go‑live deployment checklist covering authentication, admin/user features, UI/UX, data integrity, browser support, and post‑deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base definitions with custom light/dark theme CSS variables for layout, colors, and component styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the Vite/TSX bootstrap script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, authentication gating, role-based redirects, and global layout/components including profile modal and toasts.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when users lack permissions, with a message and a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for first‑time users to create their profile with name and role, saving via actor call and invalidating profile cache.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout component showing navigation, user info, and logout handling with responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Editor for adding, removing, and updating multiple payment mode entries with dynamic fields.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Filter panel for reports allowing date, salesman, payment type, and payment mode selection.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payments grouped by retailer with totals and formatted details in a table.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: Paginated invoice table with ageing-day sorting, status badges, and navigation to invoice details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that loads the current user's profile and role using the actor and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY AuthClient, including login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating invoice and payment data through an actor API, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and global base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Displays admin dashboard statistics and navigation cards using report data fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Allows admins to upload, filter, view, and clear invoice data, with XLSX parsing and template download support.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders a login page that triggers Internet Identity authentication and handles login errors.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Provides a form to edit an existing payment, preloading its data and submitting updates via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Handles entry of new invoice payments with multiple payment lines, validation, and submission to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a retailer’s full payment history with formatted details and admin edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Fetches and displays report metrics with filters and allows exporting payment reports as CSV.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine interface used for capturing individual payment line inputs.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses an uploaded CSV-like XLSX file into invoice objects, validating required columns and data.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Generates a CSV report of payment data and triggers a file download with summary and detailed rows.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Creates and downloads a CSV template containing required invoice upload columns.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides invoice filtering by retailer, invoice number, and salesman name using case-insensitive matches.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Parses invoice date strings, calculates ageing days, and formats the result for display.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes various invoice status formats into consistent status keys.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Computes total, remaining, and excess payment amounts and determines payment status.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles retrieval, storage, and cleanup of URL and session parameters for routing and persistence.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry fields, ensuring required amounts and mode-specific details are provided.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and utilities.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features for the ADPL app.
